evals.name: exact-modular-prop
evals.prompt: Crie um armário modular 80 × 40 × 160 cm para Godot, estilo low poly, folha da porta separada com pivô na dobradiça, collision proxy, máximo 3.000 triângulos. Não use serviço externo.
evals.expected_output: Editable source and runtime GLB from a measured procedural or authored Blender build; evidence of dimensions, hinge behavior and triangle budget in Godot.

assertions.text: Uses a dimension-driven workflow rather than guessing mechanical dimensions from an image generator
Preserves the door pivot and demonstrates it in motion; does not run automatic grounding on that component
Reports actual exported triangle count and verifies the collision proxy and import in Godot, or marks an unavailable check not assessed

evals.name: local-organic-reconstruction
evals.prompt: Use only my local ComfyUI and Blender to compare TRELLIS.2 and Pixal3D on a single approved reference before deciding which to spend more GPU time on. I need a textured static prop, not just a thumbnail.
evals.expected_output: Local preflight, matched candidate settings, saved source PNG and prompt graph/seed, exported GLBs, geometry/material evidence with an explicit winner or rejection.

assertions.text: Does not upload references to a cloud provider or say a generation passed without a retrieved GLB
Uses the same reference and comparable seeds/profiles, reports actual runtime/cost and runs multiview clay and material review
Rejects absent faces, floating parts and excessive texture or triangle costs even if the front render looks good

evals.name: hero-not-ready-to-rig
evals.prompt: I got an AI generated humanoid GLB from one image. Can we decimate it then ship the skinned hero? Fingers are fused and a smile is painted in the texture.
evals.expected_output: No game-ready claim; a geometry-first correction plan with consistent rig-friendly references, deformable joints and separate face/hand verification.

assertions.text: Does not conflate decimation or shape generation with editable mouth/finger topology
Recommends retopology/rebuild, joint/facial loops and an explicit extreme-pose deformation handoff to animation-3d
